mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting (particularly potassium), while benazepril reduces aldosterone-mediated potassium retention, creating synergistic risk of severe hyperkalemia and acute kidney injury.
action: Monitor serum creatinine, potassium, and magnesium closely; consider alternative antifungal or temporary ACE inhibitor discontinuation; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte replacement during concurrent use.
